name: Cursor CLI
live: unverified: built from the documented field lists and the 2026-11-27 probe log; the CLI is not installed on the owner's machine

prompt_submit.fallback: none: beforeSubmitPrompt cannot add context, so the per-turn anchor is not shown

idle.fallback: none: Cursor has no idle event

deny.why: ~/.cursor/cli-config.json carries the deny tokens below, but no run has shown they hold: the demoted rules stay dispatcher rules until the owner's probe

always_on.value: the local plugin's rules (local plugins load in the editor, the CLI and self-hosted workers)

agents.fallback: the plugin's agents; the CLI reads no home-folder subagents, so ~/.cursor/agents never was one

access.probe: frontmatter tools: with Write and Bash
access.inline: read and run in the main session
